_about: A filled example brief for scripts/new-shop.mjs. Every value is made up (020 7946 0xxx is a UK range kept for drama). Copy this file outside the repository, replace every value with the shop's own, delete _example and _about, then run: node scripts/new-shop.mjs <your copy>. Fields you do not know yet: leave them out or set them to null; the site hides what it does not know.
